note: Upper Big Blue NRD recreation area on 44-acre Recharge Lake, under a mile off Hwy 34 at York (1114 Recharge Road). RV pads are a herringbone of concrete back-ins on a dead-end spur in the NE corner; reviews report rigs to 43 ft. Archery range, docks, kayak launch, trails around the lake. Credit cards not accepted. --Claude
summary: NRD pages confirm $25 RV / $5 tent (fees already recorded), FCFS only, 14 nights per 30 days, 20/30/50 A at each RV pad but NO water hookups (shared hydrant; note's water wording ok), dump on site, no showers, mid-April to end of October. Note's '$15/night' was wrong (page $25): cleaned. Waterfront downgraded lakefront -> lakeview: the 12 pads sit 50-70 m from the lake behind a mown trail and a wooded bank.
flags: WATERFRONT: propose lakefront -> lakeview (downgrade, not applied by this file): the NRD's 2026 map and NAIP (0.2 m/px) put the RV area on a single spur road in the NE corner: ~12 angled concrete pads, 6 each side.
